question: women 15-49 literacy decreased between the two rounds - name those districts
gold_sql: SELECT "District" FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "District" <> 'State Total' GROUP BY "District" HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) < MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) ORDER BY "District"
sql_duckdb: WITH round_data AS (SELECT "State", "District", MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) AS nfhs4_literacy, MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) AS nfhs5_literacy FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "District" <> 'State Total' GROUP BY "State", "District") SELECT "District" FROM round_data WHERE nfhs5_literacy < nfhs4_literacy

attempts.response:
WITH round_data AS (
    SELECT
        "State",
        "District",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) AS nfhs4_literacy,
        MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) AS nfhs5_literacy
    FROM "district_health_factsheet"
    WHERE "District" != 'State Total'
    GROUP BY "State", "District"
)
SELECT "District"
FROM round_data
WHERE nfhs5_literacy < nfhs4_literacy;
